front: Which organelles contain small circular DNA and 70S ribosomes?
Ribosomes in the eukaryotic cytoplasm are...?
back: 80S (about 25 nm); 70S ribosomes are in prokaryotes, mitochondria and chloroplasts.
Modifies proteins (e.g. adds carbohydrate), sorts and packages them into vesicles; makes lysosomes.
RER has ribosomes and transports proteins being made; SER has no ribosomes and makes lipids and steroids.
Hydrolytic enzymes, inside a single membrane.
RER ribosomes → vesicle → Golgi body → secretory vesicle → exocytosis at the cell surface membrane.
Folds of the inner mitochondrial membrane that increase the surface area for the electron transport chain and ATP synthase.
Cilia: microtubule core (9 + 2), beat to move fluid. Microvilli: small membrane folds, no microtubules, increase surface area.
In animal cells, a pair of microtubule cylinders in the centrosome that organises the spindle during division.
Makes ribosomal RNA and assembles ribosome subunits.
